data.rationale: HDFC Bank post-merger is expected to maintain strong fundamentals with moderate loan growth normalization from 14% to 12% as the base expands. NIM compression from 3.5% to 3.3% reflects competitive pressures and liability repricing. CASA ratio improvement from 44% to 46% as retail franchise strengthens. Credit costs normalizing from 1.1% to 0.8% as asset quality stabilizes and merger impacts fade. Operating leverage driving cost-to-income ratio down from 42% to 38%. ROA improving from 1.8% to 2.0% and ROE from 16% to 18% reflecting operational efficiency gains and business mix optimization post-merger integration.
